about: Hand-written questions in the style of the HSK 1 exercise book's reading and writing parts (no listening). Each one needs: id, lesson, shape ('choice' or 'order'). A choice question has instruction, optional passage / sentence / text, options (list) and answer (the position of the right option, counting from 0), plus explain {hanzi, pinyin, english} shown after answering. Set hanziOptions to true when the options are single Chinese words, zhOptions when they are Chinese sentences, and keepOrder to true to stop the options being shuffled (for 对 / 错). An order question has text (the English), pieces (in the right order; the app shuffles them) and ending (the punctuation). Every question only uses characters from its lesson or earlier (names like 王方 aside). These were written by Claude from HSK 1 words; they are not copied from the exercise book.
